name: rate-my-code
description: Grades your code, PRs, docs, tests, and security on a 1-5 star scale with evidence-backed findings, then applies the fixes to raise the score.

interface.shortDescription: A 1-5 star scorecard for your code, PRs, docs, tests and security
interface.longDescription: Rate My Code reviews a codebase the way a reviewer would: it runs your project's own lint, typecheck, test and audit commands, scores six categories out of five stars against published anchors, and reports findings that each cite a file and line. Nothing is rounded up to be encouraging, and hard caps override the arithmetic. Every finding gets an ID so you can say "fix SEC-01" and have the fixer apply it, verify it and re-rate.
defaultPrompt: Rate this PR before I merge it.
